newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Thursday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover plunged to 878 million yuan from 2.592 billion yuan with the one-day contract the most actively traded.

Traders said trading was very dull with both banks and short-term financial centres, money brokerages run by the central bank, staying on the sidelines due to renewed rumours that the central bank would cut bank reserve ratios shortly.
The rumours have circulated in the market numerous times since late last year. Officials have declined to comment.

"The renewed rumours created uncentainties in the market," said one trader. "Financial institutions were reluctant to build long-term positions due to possible interbank rate fluctuations if the rumours turn out to be true."
Traders said they expected turnover to recover on Friday, but interbank rates were likely to move in a narrow range.
